resolves: L4's remaining gap — 'our encoder -> their decoder' was demonstrated on a few constructed frames, not swept across the length range.
method: Frames originated by our node at five lengths spanning and exceeding the on-air corpus, transmitted on air, and confirmed decoded by unmodified stock nodes. Evidence is the receiving nodes' own logs — black-box observation. No reference source was read.

results.note: beyond the corpus; the Data payload-length varint takes a second byte above 127, so frame = text + 21 rather than text + 20
MAX_FRAME — the largest frame the protocol permits

refusal_boundary.why: its Data wrapper encodes to 234 bytes, one over MAX_PAYLOAD 233, so frame::encode refuses. A silent truncation here would put a malformed frame on the air with nothing reporting it.

portnums_separately_confirmed.4: NODEINFO_APP — a stock node parsed it and updated its node database
portnums_separately_confirmed.5: ROUTING_APP — our acknowledgement, which a stock node accepted and stopped retransmitting on
portnums_separately_confirmed.70: TRACEROUTE_APP — answered by a stock node
portnums_separately_confirmed.256: the extension suite — relayed by a stock node without being read

instrument_note: MEASURED ON ALL THREE STOCK NODES AT ONCE, taking the union. A single node is not a valid instrument for 'did this reach the air': it rebroadcasts what it hears and a half-duplex radio is deaf while transmitting, so it misses much of a burst. Measuring with one receiver produced a convincing and entirely false 'the transmitter stops after two frames' on 2026-08-18, which cost a session before the union measurement retired it.

provenance.transmitter: our own node, 0x328070b9, at its -9 dBm floor
provenance.receivers: three Heltec V3, stock Meshtastic 2.7.26.54e0d8d, unmodified, region US, LongFast, tx_power=1
provenance.note: Our own nodes, our own channel, our own payloads. No third-party traffic. Publishable under docs/TESTING.md.
